figurative_meaning_en: Something that does not end or is inexhaustible
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দুর্নীতির জাল রক্তবীজের বংশের মতো শেষ হয় না।
তাদের ঝগড়া রক্তবীজের বংশের মতো চলতেই থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: This corruption network is like the lineage of Raktabija; it never ends.
Their quarrel persists like the progeny of Raktabija.
history: Refers to the demon Raktabija from Hindu mythology in the Devi Mahatmya, where each drop of his blood creates a new demon upon touching the ground, symbolizing endless proliferation until defeated by Goddess Durga.
note: Idiom draws from Puranic stories common in Bengali folklore and literature.
